The '''SIS safehouse''' was a [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] safehouse located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Disguised as the "Republic Embassy", the safehouse was an underground complex accessible by the smaller building that served as the safehouse's public front.
